title: Ali Asadullah
body:
Ali Asadullah
Ya ali..
haideriyam,qalandaram, mastam banda-e-murtaza ali hastam
Mara mee kashad ishq-e-oo har taraf.Ali asadullah ali waliyullah
Geraftam manaz name haider sharaf.. Ali asadullah ali waliyullah
Gedayam gedaye gedayane  oo,  Aseeram aseere ameere najaf

Ali asadullah ali waliyullah..(2)

Paaye haider se jo masraah ka patthar hoga

Ishq-e- haider ba khuda lutf-e-khuda..(2)

Sahibe zarf ko hota hai ata
